content: <thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an S_NAr reaction (aryl halide → aryl‑amine). The functional groups involved are breaking an aryl halide and forming a secondary amine. Using these criteria we can search the template catalog, retrieve the appropriate template ID, and then apply it to the target molecule `CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1` to obtain all possible precursor sets.</thought>
